{{Quote|Nothing wrong with 'Sharp'. It's a good name.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] gives CT-4012 his nickname|<ref name="SM1" />}}
'''Sharp''', designated '''CT-4012''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Breakout Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He earned his name for his perception and sharp [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He served in the [[Mission to Kynachi]].<ref name="SM1" /> Along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]], he was later captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and impersonated by a [[Unidentified Clawdite bounty hunter|Clawdite bounty hunter]] working for the Separatists.<ref name="SM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>
